parsed.rationale: All four duplicate `data` methods reside in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` and are nested inside per-test-class `SequentialMockSession` helper types (`iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession`, `LastFMArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession`, `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession`). Although the context flags do not carry `is_test: true` — likely a tagging gap given the file path ends in `Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` — the fully-qualified names and file path make clear these are test-internal mock session helpers, not production code. Consolidating them would couple three independent test classes through a shared mock fixture, reducing test isolation without any production benefit. The structural coincidence is an artefact of each test class independently needing the same mock URLSession hook.
